scope.purpose: bounded research-design development, not source reproduction

turbulence.model: Gamma-Gamma common scalar irradiance per window

signal_model.snr_definition: average transmit symbol energy divided by complex AWGN variance per polarization

metrics.primary: payload BER = total bit errors / total payload bits

bootstrap.stream_rule: reset the preregistered PCG64 seed for each named paired comparison

terminal_rules.difference_sign: candidate BER minus baseline BER; lower is better
terminal_rules.strongest_B1_B2: lower evaluation pooled BER; exact tie chooses B1 as simpler recipe
terminal_rules.C4_STRUCTURED_SIGNAL: C4 vs strongest(B1,B2) clears improvement in at least one Np=2 cell, is not significantly worse in the other Np=2 cell, has no significant Np=4 regression, and all four cells are finite/correct
terminal_rules.SIMPLE_ROBUST_LS_SIGNAL: if C4 rule fails, B1 or B2 vs B0 satisfies the same Np=2 improvement/non-regression and Np=4 no-regression gate; choose lower evaluation BER across four cells, exact tie B1
terminal_rules.LOCAL_ONLY: some Np=2 deployable arm has negative mean BER difference without a closed improvement CI, or any candidate/simple arm has significant Np=4 regression
terminal_rules.NO_METHOD_SIGNAL: no stable deployable BER signal, or O1 has no positive pooled BER headroom over the strongest deployable arm

only_next_step.C4_STRUCTURED_SIGNAL: fresh confirmation of frozen C4 recipe
only_next_step.SIMPLE_ROBUST_LS_SIGNAL: fresh confirmation of frozen simple robust-LS winner
only_next_step.LOCAL_ONLY: record supporting evidence only; no confirmation authorization
only_next_step.NO_METHOD_SIGNAL: close this short-pilot structure family; return only to C4-0
only_next_step.INVALID_TESTBED: repair testbed under a separately authorized task
